Actual Article Body:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the U.S. military is intentionally delaying the delivery of more Patriot interceptor missiles for Ukraine’s air defense system despite NATO already paying for them.

Zelensky made the statement during a virtual meeting with U.S. senators on both sides of the aisle as the Ukrainian leader’s relationship with President Donald Trump deteriorates.
